subject.title: [Feature Request] Multi-window session support - new window pauses existing sessions

question: Should OpenClaw desktop support multiple concurrent native chat windows now, and should the existing browser active-run guard remain or change to allow creating another session while one run is active?
rationale: The backend create-session primitive exists, but choosing the desktop window model, active-run visibility, native /new behavior, and whether concurrent session creation is allowed while another run is active changes user-facing product semantics beyond a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Design Native Multi-Window Sessions
options.body: Keep this issue open and have macOS/session owners define the window registry, session subscription, and /new/create behavior before implementation.

options.title: Limit To Browser Flat Sessions
options.body: Treat the shipped Control UI create/switch flow as the current product boundary and explicitly defer native multi-window desktop behavior.

options.title: Split Browser And macOS Follow-Ups
options.body: Keep this issue for macOS desktop windows and open a separate narrower product question for the Control UI active-run creation guard if maintainers want that changed.

recommendation.title: Design Native Multi-Window Sessions
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and have macOS/session owners define the window registry, session subscription, and /new/create behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history on macOS WebChat/window routing and recent session-thread work, so they are the best available owner for the product decision.
